name: yuantu-agent
description: Independent YuanTu coding agent runtime, CLI and desktop

scripts.package:windows: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-package.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 && node scripts/write-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.package:windows:dir: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-package.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --dir
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.smoke:desktop: node scripts/run-tests.mjs tests/desktop.smoke.mjs tests/settings.smoke.mjs tests/history.smoke.mjs tests/backups.smoke.mjs tests/workflows.smoke.mjs tests/agent.smoke.mjs tests/knowledge.smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run docs:check && npm run references:check && npm run i18n:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:client && npm run smoke:web
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run smoke:desktop
